{{Quote|We will always be indebted to Gardulla for her efforts on our behalf.|Cabra|<ref name="DP" />}}
'''Cabra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]]. He had many offspring with [[Darnada]] being the youngest. Cabra was given leave to operate on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] as part of the deal [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] brokered with [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]]. In exchange for this, Damask supported the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] takeover of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="DP" />
